data: Greg a fondé une entreprise nommée Alibi.com qui crée tout type d'alibi. Avec Augustin son associé, et Medhi son nouvel employé, ils élaborent des stratagèmes et mises en scène imparables pour couvrir leurs clients. Mais la rencontre de Flo, une jolie blonde qui déteste les hommes qui mentent, va compliquer la vie de Greg, qui commence par lui cacher la vraie nature de son activité. Lors de la présentation aux parents, Greg comprend que Gérard, le père de Flo, est aussi un de leurs clients... (Greg’s startup Alibi.com is a huge success. Who knew so many people would pay big bucks for an alibi to hide their secret lives? Helped by his devoted, nerdy business partner Augustin and eccentric new employee Medhi, Greg is on a lucky streak. He even meets Flo—the girl of his dreams. But she hates liars, so he pretends to be an airline attendant, and things get tricky keeping up the charade. Especially when he meets his future father-in-law, who happens to be one of his clients! Can he save face in the eyes of his fiancée’s family, keep his company from fechnbeing exposed, and avoid scandal and total ruin?)

Greg’s startup Alibi.com is a huge success. Who knew so many people would pay big bucks for an alibi to hide their secret lives? Helped by his devoted, nerdy business partner Augustin and eccentric new employee Medhi, Greg is on a lucky streak. He even meets Flo—the girl of his dreams. But she hates liars, so he pretends to be an airline attendant, and things get tricky keeping up the charade. Especially when he meets his future father-in-law, who happens to be one of his clients!
